resize(n, kl, ku, v=0.0).scientific_purpose: Allocate banded storage with 2*kl + ku + 1 rows for DGBTRF partial pivoting

bfill(v=0.0).scientific_purpose: Fill banded matrix storage with scalar value

value(i, j).scientific_purpose: Read matrix element A(i, j) in band storage or return 0 outside band

setValue(i, j, v).scientific_purpose: Assign matrix element A(i, j) with boundary/bandwidth validation

mult(b, prod=None).scientific_purpose: Matrix-vector product prod = A * b using band limits

leftMult(b, prod=None).scientific_purpose: Transposed matrix-vector product prod = b * A

factor().scientific_purpose: Compute LU factorization with partial row pivoting in compact band storage

solve(b).scientific_purpose: Solve linear system A * x = b for vector or multi-RHS matrix b

rcond(a1norm=0.0).scientific_purpose: Compute reciprocal 1-norm condition number estimate (LAPACK DGBCON / DGETRF)

checkRows(value).scientific_purpose: Check that each row contains at least one entry exceeding threshold

checkColumns(value).scientific_purpose: Check that each column contains at least one entry exceeding threshold
